children: Shares of Orion Energy Systems rose after the company said it deployed another of its MPHL2 LED Lighting solutions for a large data-center operator.
The stock climbed 16% to $29 Tuesday. Shares have nearly doubled in value year to date.
Orion didn't disclose the name of the customer, describing it instead as "one of the world's largest data-center operators."
The multi-million dollar order comes shortly after Orion's first multimillion-dollar deployment for the global hyperscaler in June, the company said.

"Orion is extremely gratified to have earned this global leader's confidence so quickly that it is tasking us at its second facility only three months after the first," Chief Executive Sally Washlow said.

The company said its customizable MPHL2 LED Lighting solution can deliver higher-energy efficiency, resiliency and decarbonization. The high-efficiency linear lighting fixture is designed and built to accommodate nearly every data center's floor plan, while reducing the energy usage for lighting, Orion added.
